class.name: VCSVParser
class.brief_description:
Low-level RFC 4180 CSV/DSV parser.
低层 RFC 4180 CSV/DSV 解析器。
class.description:
[b]VCSVParser[/b] turns CSV/DSV text (or a file) into a [VCSVTable] of raw strings. It is a single-pass C++ state machine that handles quoted fields, escaped quotes, multi-line fields, CRLF/LF/CR line endings, BOM stripping, comment lines and configurable delimiters — with no type conversion (see [VCSVDataTable] for that).
Both methods are static; the options parameter may be [code]null[/code] for defaults.
[b]VCSVParser[/b] 把 CSV/DSV 文本（或文件）解析为纯字符串的 [VCSVTable]。它是单遍 C++ 状态机，支持引号字段、转义引号、多行字段、CRLF/LF/CR 行尾、BOM 剥离、注释行、可配置分隔符——不做类型转换（类型转换见 [VCSVDataTable]）。
两个方法均为静态；options 参数可为 [code]null[/code] 使用默认值。

method.name: parse_string
method.description:
Parses [param text] and returns a structured [VCSVParseResult].
解析 [param text] 并返回结构化的 [VCSVParseResult]。

method.name: parse_file
method.description:
Reads the file as bytes, decodes it with [member VCSVParseOptions.encoding] ([code]utf8[/code] by default, or [code]gbk[/code] / [code]gb2312[/code]), strips a UTF-8 BOM when enabled, then parses.
以字节读取文件，按 [member VCSVParseOptions.encoding]（默认 [code]utf8[/code]，或 [code]gbk[/code] / [code]gb2312[/code]）解码，启用时剥离 UTF-8 BOM，再解析。
